name: obsidian-crate
description: Sync vault files and reminders with Cloudflare R2.
author: Kaan Biryol

scripts.build:site: npm run build:site:main && npm run build:site:crate-ui
scripts.test:local-server: npm run build:worker && node --test scripts/local-server.test.mjs scripts/local-server-tunnel.test.mjs scripts/local-server-quick.test.mjs scripts/local-server-pairing.test.mjs scripts/local-server-backup.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run typecheck && npm run build:plugin
scripts.size-check: npm run size-check:plugin && npm run size-check:worker && npm run size-check:pwa
scripts.release:check: npm run security:check && npm run check && npm run test:pwa-preview && npm run build:plugin && npm run check:css-scope && npm run size-check && npm run verify:release-artifacts && npm run typecheck:visual && npm run test:visual && npm run test:activity-browser && npm run test:pwa-browser && npm run release:candidate
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:worker-runtime: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts
scripts.benchmark:reminders: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts src/cloudflare/worker/reminder-capacity.integration.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run test:worker-runtime && npm run test:local-server
scripts.check:source: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:worker && npm run deadcode && npm run notices:check && npm run test:ci && npm run test:server-revision && npm run check:server-revision && npm run test:recovery && npm test
scripts.security:check: npm run security:audit && npm run security:secrets
scripts.benchmark:sync: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts src/cloudflare/worker/sync-capacity.integration.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:activity-browser: node scripts/activity-empty-layout-test.mjs && node scripts/activity-diff-test.mjs && node scripts/conflict-review-test.mjs
scripts.test:page-titles: npm run build && vitest run src/cloudflare/worker/link-title.test.ts src/sync/page-title.test.ts src/pwa/page-title-api.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts src/cloudflare/worker/link-title.integration.ts && playwright test tests/visual/page-titles.spec.ts tests/visual/lexical-trial.spec.ts --workers=2
scripts.test:lexical: vitest run src/reminders/components/lexical/reminderDocument.test.ts && playwright test tests/visual/lexical-trial.spec.ts tests/visual/page-titles.spec.ts --workers=2 && playwright test --config tests/editor-contract/playwright.config.ts && node scripts/pwa-editor-contract-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-editor-selection-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-ui-performance-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-focus-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-draft-recovery-test.mjs && node scripts/pwa-update-test.mjs
